name: Chlorhexadol
summary: Chloralodol (chlorhexadol) is a hypnotic/sedative. It is a Schedule III drug in the United States; however, it is not currently marketed in the US so it is no longer prescribed.

uses.text: It is a Schedule III drug in the United States; however, it is not currently marketed in the US so it is no longer prescribed.

pharmacology.en: It is thought to work like other chloral drugs, breaking down in the body to release chloral, which is turned into trichloroethanol, a depressant of the nervous system.
pharmacology.zh: 一般認為它的作用方式與其他氯醛類藥物相同：在體內分解釋出氯醛，再轉化為會抑制神經系統的三氯乙醇。
pharmacology.zhHans: 一般认为它的作用方式与其他氯醛类药物相同：在体内分解发布氯醛，再转化为会抑制神经系统的三氯乙醇。

sideEffects.en: Little detailed information is available. Chloral-type sleeping drugs can cause drowsiness, dizziness and stomach upset, can lead to dependence, and in overdose can cause coma and dangerous heart rhythm problems.
sideEffects.zh: 關於它的詳細資料很少。氯醛類安眠藥可能造成嗜睡、頭暈與腸胃不適，可能導致依賴，過量時可能造成昏迷與危險的心律不整。
sideEffects.zhHans: 关于它的详细数据很少。氯醛类安眠药可能造成嗜睡、头晕与肠胃不适，可能导致依赖，过量时可能造成昏迷与危险的心律不整。

fact.en: Chlorhexadol is chloral joined to hexylene glycol, a solvent also used in paints and cosmetics. Chemists combined chloral with other molecules like this to make it gentler on the stomach.
fact.zh: 氯丙醇是把氯醛與己二醇結合而成，己二醇是一種也用在油漆與化妝品中的溶劑。化學家用這種方式把氯醛和其他分子結合，好讓它對胃比較溫和。
fact.zhHans: 氯丙醇是把氯醛与己二醇结合而成，己二醇是一种也用在油漆与化妆品中的溶剂。化学家用这种方式把氯醛和其他分子结合，好让它对胃比较温和。
